jobs.title: Academy Engineer - (Data Scientist- Training)
jobs.description:
What Cognite is Relentless to Achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. Our Moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

About Cognite Academy

Cognite Academy enables customers, partners, and internal teams to build the product knowledge and practical skills required to successfully adopt, implement, and scale Cognite solutions.

Our goal is not simply to create training content. We build learning experiences that help people become productive faster, implement Cognite solutions successfully, follow best practices, and ultimately accelerate customer value realization.

As an Academy Engineer, you will play a critical role in this mission by combining deep technical expertise, instructional thinking, content creation, and training delivery.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Academy Engineer who can translate complex Cognite technology and real-world implementation practices into engaging, practical, and scalable learning experiences.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and other subject matter experts to understand what customers and partners need to know, identify learning gaps, and turn that knowledge into high-quality training courses, hands-on exercises, labs, demonstrations, and instructor-led programs.

This is a highly collaborative role with significant ownership. You will not simply be handed a curriculum to deliver. You will help shape what we teach, how we teach it, and how learners demonstrate their ability to apply it.

The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a data engineer/data scientist, technical consultant, and educator. You should be comfortable working hands-on with technology, presenting to a room of technical professionals, creating learning content, and continuously learning new products and technologies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Subject Matter Expertise

Develop deep expertise in Cognite Data Fusion® and the broader Cognite product portfolio relevant to Academy training.

Serve as a technical subject matter expert within the Academy team, helping ensure that training content reflects current product capabilities, implementation practices, and industry use cases.

Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Professional Services, Solutions Architects, and other internal SMEs to understand product functionality, upcoming capabilities, and real-world implementation requirements.

Identify knowledge and skills gaps across customers, partners, and internal teams and translate these gaps into actionable learning requirements.

Contribute to the Academy curriculum roadmap by recommending new courses, learning paths, hands-on labs, and advanced technical training.

Continuously validate and refresh existing content as Cognite products, technologies, and best practices evolve.

2. Training Content & Learning Experience Development

Design and develop high-quality technical training for audiences ranging from beginners to experienced data engineers, data scientists, solution architects, and implementation professionals.

Create a variety of learning assets, including:

Self-paced e-learning courses

Instructor-led training

Technical demonstrations

Hands-on exercises and labs

Assessments and quizzes

Workshops and bootcamps

Technical documentation and job aids

Translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured, and learner-friendly content without compromising technical depth.

Apply instructional design and adult learning principles to create learning experiences that are practical, engaging, and focused on measurable learning outcomes.

Design hands-on exercises that allow learners to practice skills in realistic scenarios rather than simply consume information.

Contribute to standardized Academy content development processes, templates, quality standards, and design systems.

3. Digital & Creative Content Development

Use modern learning and content-authoring technologies to create engaging digital learning experiences.

Develop video-based learning, demonstrations, animations, interactive activities, and other digital learning assets using tools such as Synthesia, Articulate Rise, and other Academy technologies.

Experiment with AI-powered content development tools and emerging learning technologies to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of Academy content development.

Work with the Academy team to continuously improve the learner experience across the LMS and other learning platforms.

Ensure that digital learning content is technically accurate, visually engaging, accessible, and aligned with Academy standards.

4. Technical Training Delivery

Deliver engaging instructor-led training to customers, partners, and internal employees through virtual and in-person formats.

Facilitate training programs ranging from foundational courses such as CDF Fundamentals to advanced technical programs such as multi-day CDF Delivery Bootcamps.

Adapt delivery style and depth based on the audience's technical background, role, industry, and learning objectives.

Facilitate technical discussions, demonstrations, exercises, workshops, and troubleshooting sessions.

Create a learning environment where participants feel comfortable asking questions and applying concepts hands-on.

Collect and analyze learner feedback and use it to continuously improve course content and delivery.

Travel internationally or within the region for customer, partner, and internal training events, expected to be approximately up to 25% of the time.

5. Customer & Partner Enablement

Develop training that directly supports successful Cognite implementations and adoption.

Understand the different technical personas within the Cognite ecosystem, including data engineers, data scientists, solution architects, developers, and other implementation professionals.

Ensure that training prepares learners not only to understand Cognite products, but to apply them successfully in real-world industrial environments.

Partner with Professional Services and Customer Success teams to identify recurring customer and partner capability gaps that can be addressed through scalable Academy programs.

Contribute to certification and skills-based learning programs where appropriate.

6. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Work collaboratively across Academy, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and other functions to ensure alignment between product development and learning content.

Actively participate in Academy content planning, reviews, and quality assurance activities.

Bring feedback from customers and training participants back into the product and Academy organizations.

Continuously evaluate what is working and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency of Academy learning programs.

Stay current with emerging technologies in AI, data engineering, DataOps, and industrial data platforms and assess their relevance to Cognite's learning portfolio.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

Technical Experience

Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

2+ years of professional experience in a technical role such as Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Software Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Consultant.

Strong hands-on experience with Python and SQL.

Experience working with data platforms, DataOps technologies, cloud platforms, or industrial data environments.

Experience with Cognite Data Fusion® is highly desirable. Experience with similar industrial data platforms or DataOps environments will also be considered.

Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Active Directory.

Strong understanding of data engineering, data modeling, APIs, and cloud-based data platforms.

Ability and enthusiasm to quickly learn new technologies and become a credible technical SME.

Training & Communication Experience

Experience delivering technical training, workshops, bootcamps, demonstrations, or technical presentations to professional audiences.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of technical expertise.

Experience creating technical learning content, documentation, tutorials, labs, or other educational materials.

Understanding of instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.

Experience with learning management systems and digital authoring tools is highly desirable.

Familiarity with tools such as Skilljar, Articulate Rise, Articulate Storyline, Synthesia, or similar platforms is a plus.

Mindset & Personal Attributes

Learner first: You care deeply about whether people can actually apply what they have learned.

Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how technology works and are energized by learning new products and emerging technologies.

Strong ownership: You take responsibility for the quality and outcomes of your work rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

Clear communicator: You can move comfortably between deep technical discussions and explaining concepts to someone encountering them for the first time.

Practical problem solver: You focus on real-world application and enjoy creating hands-on experiences that help people solve problems.

Collaborative: You are comfortable working with SMEs and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Academy.

Creative and adaptable: You are willing to experiment with new tools, AI technologies, and approaches to make learning faster, better, and more scalable.

Customer obsessed: You understand that the ultimate measure of effective training is whether it helps customers and partners successfully use Cognite technology and realize value.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means that you:

Become a trusted technical SME for key areas of the Cognite product portfolio.

Consistently produce technically accurate, engaging, and scalable learning experiences.

Help expand and improve the Academy's technical curriculum and learning paths.

Deliver high-quality training that enables customers and partners to become productive faster.

Create hands-on learning experiences that build practical implementation skills.

Identify emerging capability gaps and proactively turn them into new learning solutions.

Build strong relationships with Product, Professional Services, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

Continuously improve Academy content, learner experience, and training effectiveness.

Why Join Cognite Academy?

This is an opportunity to help shape how customers and partners around the world learn, adopt, and implement industrial AI and data technology.

You will work at the intersection of technology, education, customer success, and AI, while having significant ownership over the learning experiences that enable Cognite's global ecosystem.

If you are a technically strong professional who enjoys both building technology and teaching others how to use it, this role offers the opportunity to make a direct and measurable impact on Cognite's customers, partners, and growth.

Why Cognite

You will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve problems that actually matter at scale — not hypothetical ones. You'll join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where curiosity and ownership are the norm, not the exception. If you want delivery work you can point to and be proud of, we'd love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

Strategic Value Selling: Ability to sell value and build quantified ROI frameworks for prospective buyers.

Informal Leadership, Influence & Autonomy: High degree of self-motivation, time management, and ability to informally lead and effectively influence cross-functional deal teams.

Executive Communication: Stellar presentation, written, and verbal communication skills tailored for C-suite engagement.

Enterprise Software/SaaS: Proven mastery of selling complex analytics or data platforms (e.g., AI, Big Data, Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Machine Learning).

Our primary focus is to inspire and educate the market, generating high-quality leads that fuel the sales pipeline. Overview of the BDR role

The Business Development Representative (BDR) drives pipeline growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying leads.

This role is one of the first touchpoints for prospects, and it has the opportunity to set the tone for the sales cycle that follows.

You will possess expertise in understanding the unique challenges faced by clients in the manufacturing sector, and your role is crucial in initiating relationships with potential customers.

A significant part of your job will involve following up with inbound leads promptly, ensuring that no opportunities are missed.

Working closely with the sales team and marketing, your proactive approach will ensure a steady flow of high-quality leads, enabling the sales team to focus on closing deals and expanding existing accounts.

Follow up on inbound marketing leads, identifying qualified opportunities and providing the right level of information to engaged prospects.

Run qualification meetings with prospects to deeply understand their needs and determine fit. The goal is to transfer as many high-quality opportunities as possible to the sales team.

Collaborate closely with strategic account executives to develop account intelligence, stakeholder maps, and use case opportunities through direct engagement and insight tools.

Partner effectively with Cogniters across various teams to enhance collaboration and achieve shared goals.

Engage in bright and meaningful phone, email, and social media conversations to build relationships with potential clients.

Serve as the subject matter expert on Cognite's product offerings, clearly conveying their value to prospects.

Craft personalized messages for key stakeholders in target accounts and develop effective outreach tactics.

Continuously seek to improve and optimize both outbound and inbound efforts to enhance overall effectiveness.

Conduct thorough research and account planning for target accounts to inform your outreach strategy.

Work closely with the Marketing team to support campaigns through initial outreach and post-campaign follow-ups, driving engagement with target accounts.

You bring 1-3 years of experience in sales development within the technology or industrial sector, showcasing your ability to drive results and foster relationships.

You are proficient in prospecting using various sales tools, including Zoominfo, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Outreach, and 6Sense, enabling you to effectively engage with potential clients.

Experience in the Energy and/or Manufacturing industry is a distinct advantage, giving you insights into sector-specific challenges.

Interest and experience within the AI space are highly advantageous

You are motivated to design and optimize best practices for the BDR role.

With exceptional oral and written communication skills, you excel at listening and fostering positive, energetic conversations in person, virtually, and over the phone.

You have a keen ability to understand customer business initiatives, pain points, and requirements, and correlate them with the business value Cognite can provide.

Your strong organizational skills allow you to manage multiple requests and time demands simultaneously while achieving production goals across your assigned territory or accounts.

You are eager to learn about the Manufacturing vertical, demonstrating your commitment to professional growth.

You are comfortable with travel across the US and Europe, as part of your role.

Proactive by nature, you thrive in a self-directed environment and deliver results without the need for micromanagement.

You effectively collaborate with a global team, navigating the challenges of different time zones with ease.

Disciplined and persistent, you uphold strong work ethics that drive your success.

Your confidence shines through in your interactions, helping you establish trust and rapport with clients.

Quickly follow up on any new inbound leads to ensure timely engagement with interested prospects.

Prospecting by using sales tools like ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, Salesforce, and LinkedIn to identify and research potential leads within target accounts.

Conducting outreach activities through phone calls, emails, and social media, personalizing messages based on the prospect's needs and industry.

Following up with leads generated from recent outreach efforts or events, ensuring that prospects remain engaged.

Researching target accounts to understand their pain points and identify new opportunities for engagement.

We are looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.

You will work across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka, supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.

You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.

What You’ll Own

Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration

Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.

Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.

Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.

Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.

Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL.

Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.

Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations

Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.

Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.

Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.

Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore.

Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.

Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.

Kafka Streaming Infrastructure

Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.

Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

As Senior HR Advisor, Americas, you serve as the regional center of excellence for employment compliance, independent investigations, and policy architecture. While People Business Partners (PBPs) partner with business units on talent strategy and team design, you act as the senior technical authority across our Americas footprint. Reporting to the VP, P&O Operations & Rewards, you partner with local People Operations (who manage day-to-day HR workflows) and collaborate closely with PBPs and global colleagues. The timing is exceptional. Cognite is being acquired by Schneider Electric, our Americas region is growing, and the policies and benefits are being aligned. At the same time, we are building an AI-first P&O with HiBob as our system of record and AI tools, such as Claude. This position is based out of our HQ in Tempe, AZ; hybrid work model with 3 days a week in office.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

What You'll Own and Shape

Policy ownership, redesign and implementation

Own the US policy set: Review, assess and modernize the US Employee Handbook and regional policies, with a firm bias toward simplicity, clarity and practical usability over complexity.

Turn cases into better policy: When real cases show a policy no longer holds up, bring tested recommendations and drive their implementation.

Keep policy current and audit-ready: Maintain policies across every state where we employ people, ready for internal and external audit and governance reviews, including SOX-style controls.

Translate the law into guidance: Keep us up to date on laws and regulations that affect us and turn it into clear, accessible guidance for managers and employees across our multi-state footprint (AZ, TX, and growing remote workforce).

Harmonize through the acquisition: Partner with the VP, P&O Operations & Rewards and the M&A working group to evaluate, align, and draft harmonized policy frameworks as Cognite integrates with Schneider Electric.

Complex cases, compliance and employee relations

Resolve the hard cases, end to end: Partner on challenging employee relations matters, from conflict and complaints to conduct and performance.

Bring in Legal at the right moment: Work with internal and external counsel on specialized employment matters, litigation prevention and regulatory updates.

Experience implementing or administering an ethics hotline, speak-up program, or formal reporting channel, and familiarity with audit readiness (SOX or similar)

Calm, discreet and fair under pressure
